debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), missing EMA/SMA alignment, zero fundamental support, crisis-level VIX (384.48), unfavourable macro, high earnings risk in 76 days, and no active strategy triggers create execution risk that outweighs momentum signals.
